sections.title: Review finding
sections.content: Round 5 repair addresses custody and execution-proof findings. It preserves pre-implementation status and identifies required corrections to mappings, command execution, receipt validation, adapter composition, registry bindings, and closure scope.

sections.title: Implementation contract
sections.content: Plan is self-hosted and plan-ready. S0 through S5 define required validation command identities; terminal validation is the Round 5 terminal script. No authorization is granted.

sections.title: Plan state
sections.content: Repair round 5 is repair-validated. All implementation slices remain pending, with dependency ordering defined. State explicitly excludes implementation authorization, completion, acceptance, and archival.

sections.title: Round 5 coverage mapping
sections.content: Superseding requirement-to-acceptance mapping covers VCEC-001 through VCEC-036 and acceptance IDs A01 through A43. It assigns source-freeze, scope, readonly, dogfood, and other command identities to relevant slices without authorization.

sections.title: Repair target
sections.content: The bounded target is the exact-cover execution-plan directory. Supplied finding, mapping, contract, and state are sufficient only for a non-authorizing VDD plan repair; implementation and runtime conformance decisions remain out of scope.
